request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier sent a quote. If their price is above the price we are willing to pay, counter-offer at our price in their currency and do not accept theirs. Ask for every term they did not state (MOQ, lead time, payment terms). Keep what they did state.
request.user:
Our order: 2000 pcs of aluminium laptop stand. The most we are willing to pay: USD 5.56 per pcs (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Buenos Aires. Logo printing: no. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Jinhai Household Products
Supplier message:
Hi,
Thanks for your inquiry about the aluminium laptop stand.
Our best price is USD 6.90 per pcs EXW Xiamen.
If you prefer, we can also offer DDP to your warehouse at USD 8.71 per pcs.
Production needs 15 days.
Payment: 30% T/T deposit, 70% before shipment.
Looking forward to your order.
Best regards
What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"quote","quote":{"price":6.9,"currency":"USD","moq":null,"moq_unit":null,"lead_time_days":15,"incoterm":"EXW","payment_terms":"30% T/T deposit, 70% before shipment"}}

text:
{"reply":"Dear Jinhai Household Products,

Thank you for your quote. For 2000 pcs aluminium laptop stand, please quote USD 5.56 per pcs EXW Xiamen, with export cartons and no logo printing.

Please also advise your MOQ and confirm the lead time and payment terms.

Best regards."}
